fields.retrieval_id: Opaque per-search identifier; generated only when the user opts in
fields.query_hash: SHA-256 of normalized query; raw query text is not persisted in these collections
fields.evidence_id: Stable corpus chunk_id actually shown to the user
fields.shown_at: Timestamp when the source passage was returned
fields.helpful_label: Boolean user-reported usefulness label; not a clinical outcome
fields.system_version: Retriever/tokenizer/version string used for this search

privacy: No account/user identifier, free-text comment, patient record, or raw query text is stored by this pilot schema.
interpretation: Feedback describes retrieval usefulness only. It is not evidence of clinical correctness, safety, or patient benefit. Do not use it as a treatment label or train a clinical ML model from it.
review: One manually submitted local smoke-test usefulness rating is stored in the user's local VedAI database; it is not a research sample or clinical label. Further capture occurs only when a search explicitly includes feedback_consent=true and MongoDB is connected. Review consent wording, ethics requirements, retention, and access controls before participant recruitment.
